title: Compare digit character classes
description: This example shows that Python's \d accepts Unicode decimal digits while [0-9] accepts ASCII digits.

steps.description: The loop tests an ASCII digit string and a string containing Devanagari digits.

steps.question: Which pattern matches the Devanagari digit string?

steps.description: fullmatch tests both patterns against each complete string and prints their Boolean results.
The output makes the two digit-class definitions visible for each test string.
